description: Install app builds from URLs, including signed CI artifact download URLs. The command allows 600s, including up to 120s for the download; local Android and iOS install steps time out after 120s. Times out after 600s.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

retentionMs.description: When retainPaths is true, keep downloaded and extracted files for this many milliseconds.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

name: install-from-source
title: Install app builds from URLs
